title: Project Capricorn
author: ReignMocap
selftext: I hope my post doesn't break any rules. This is a mod I created but I am thinking of turning it into an actual AR game/experience. Of course I will design a new character and not use Capri. I am still torn between an AI experience where she exists in your real space or some kind of desktop game. Just wanted to share what I've been building in an AI safe space where the chance of hate will be lower. I received a lot of hate recently.

comments.author: rafaeldecastr
comments.body: I liked, i laught, i upvoted!

replies.author: ReignMocap
replies.body: Tks bud. It's stupid and fun

comments.author: Wolfran13
comments.body: I liked the 2d ar and the little face box. Looks visually interesting in simplicity

comments.author: monkey-jax
comments.body: This is actually crazy good, the speed of the replies and the quality is just insane

comments.author: Infinitecontextlabs
comments.body: Sweet!! What model are you using?

replies.author: Infinitecontextlabs
replies.body: Nice, have you ever thought about making an experience where most of it is on the desktop or console but then to jack into the net they put the VR headset on?

replies.author: ReignMocap
replies.body: Yep. At this point it's actually trivial to do. Maybe I'll try to make it.

replies.author: Infinitecontextlabs
replies.body:
My only worry would be the swaps becoming more of a physical annoyance for the player over time causing people to stop playing. So it might still need to be optional or have big incentives tied to it or something. 

Maybe the longer they have the headset on the more their cyberpsychosis grows. The better they are at stealthy in and outs of the net, the bigger the buff is when they come back out in the real world.

replies.author: ReignMocap
replies.body: I am sorry. I lost the plot. I don't understand.

replies.author: Infinitecontextlabs
replies.body: I was just brainstorming game mechanics for a game. My assumption was that, since you were using cyberpunk in the demo, you were planning to make a cyberpunk style game around it.

comments.author: Mr_Overclock
comments.body: Very cool! How did you generate the character’s voice? Wich tool? I imagine it could get pretty complicated (and expensive!) if you have a lot of dialogue variations.

replies.author: ReignMocap
replies.body: This is not pre recorded. This is fully Ai enabled. She talks, fights and does her own thing.

replies.author: Mr_Overclock
replies.body: Got it! So the dialogue is generated dynamically. I’m curious about the voice synthesis itself. Which TTS engine are you using? Is it running locally or through a cloud API?

replies.author: noparkinghere
replies.body:
yeah but how are you reading 
your voice, creating the voice clips in real time?

comments.author: revel911
comments.body: There are like 3 of these out there … wish would work together towards a better single version.

comments.author: revel911
comments.body: Curious if there is a way to customize your own AI version. Name? Voice? Visuals? That way it feels less a rip off of Edgerunner and part of your own story.
